name: folio
description: Folio — a quiet archive that keeps long chats light.

shortenOutputs.title: Shorten long shell outputs
shortenOutputs.description: A shell command's output over 8,000 characters reaches Claude as its start, its end and a note. Folio saves the whole output first, and recall gives back any of it word for word. On by default; turn it off to keep every output whole in the chat.

projectLayout.title: Tell Claude where this project keeps its files
projectLayout.description: Once per chat, Folio reads where the project already keeps each kind of file (renders, editing projects, references, sound) and tells Claude to save new files of each kind there. It never moves a file, and a project with no clear layout gets no note. On by default; turn it off to leave file places to Claude.
